nodes.label: Emotional Direction (Phase 1 design intent)
nodes.rationale: Before writing any code, define the emotional feeling the site should evoke. The skill mandates choosing one of six emotional directions (cinematic power, playful wonder, refined luxury, raw energy, futuristic precision, editorial warmth) to avoid generic 'clean and modern' output.

nodes.label: Awwwards Checklist (Visual, Motion, Feel, Code, Mobile)
Performance Without Compromise (transform+opacity only)
nodes.rationale: Only animate transform and opacity (GPU-composited) to avoid layout thrash. Use will-change sparingly, prefer CSS for simple transitions, GSAP for sequenced/scroll animations, and requestAnimationFrame for canvas loops.

Mobile Design Guide — Lume Skill Reference
Mobile Navigation Patterns (Bottom Sheet + Full-Screen Overlay)
Horizontal Scroll Mobile Fallback (swipe carousel or vertical stack)
Responsive Typography — Full Fluid Type Scale with clamp()
Zustand Player Store (global player state source of truth)
No YouTube iFrame Constraint (audio via HTML audio element only)
nodes.rationale: The frontend reproduces music using an HTML <audio> element. YouTube iframes and direct YouTube calls from the browser are explicitly forbidden. All catalog and streaming goes through FastAPI to keep the architecture clean and avoid browser-side YouTube integration.

nodes.label: Use .venv/bin yt-dlp (not global PATH)
nodes.rationale: yt-dlp must be invoked via python -m yt_dlp inside the venv, never via the global PATH, because the backend can run without the venv being activated.
